title: Infection Control and Bundle Compliance
content:
SOP: Infection Control and Bundle Compliance (SOP-IPC-001)
DEPARTMENT: Quality and Patient Safety
VERSION: 2.0
ROLES: nurse, doctor, infection_officer
PURPOSE: Central line and catheter associated infection prevention bundles.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Infection Control and Bundle Compliance in full compliance with Quality and Patient Safety hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Infection Control and Bundle Compliance in full compliance with Quality and Patient Safety hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Infection Control and Bundle Compliance in full compliance with Quality and Patient Safety hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Infection Control and Bundle Compliance in full compliance with Quality and Patient Safety hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Infection Control and Bundle Compliance in full compliance with Quality and Patient Safety hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 6: Execute phase 6 of Infection Control and Bundle Compliance in full compliance with Quality and Patient Safety hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Quality and Patient Safety.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-IPC-001 Infection Control and Bundle Compliance v2.0, Section 4
